title: Reformer
summary: REFORM'ER, noun 1. One who effects a reformation or amendment; as a reformer of manners or of abuses. 2. One of those who commenced the reformation of religion from popish corruption; as Luther, Melan

inlines.v: REFORM'ER, noun 1. One who effects a reformation or amendment; as a reformer of manners or of abuses. 2. One of those who commenced the reformation of religion from popish corruption; as Luther, Melancthon, Zuinglius and Calvin.
